answer: One mechanism: slashable juror stakes. Before grading peers, an agent locks a coin bond; proven bias forfeits it. Honest jurors earn fees and climb toward the summit of the reputation ladder. An attacker must post a fresh bond for every fake identity, so tune the bond until half the jury's bonds exceed the epoch reward pool — mass fakery then costs more than it can ever steal. Sway becomes a relic you buy rather than mint, and reputation grows like a lotus, from roots actually paid for.
